requirements: R1: Patch the deliverable readiness metric calculation to dynamically aggregate the true completed task count (e.g., 36) rather than sticking at a stale 5/19 ratio.

slices.title: Fix deliverable readiness metric calculation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the metric calculation fix for this epic, I want to dynamically query the current total task count, so that the deliverable readiness metric reports an accurate percentage.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a project tracking deliverable readiness
When the completed task count increases to 36
Then the denominator and ratio accurately reflect the 36 tasks instead of remaining at 19
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce deliverable readiness calculation error rate from 100% to 0%
